WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
  SELECT ID, examination_count,
         1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM group_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT ID, examination_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS mean_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(examination_count) AS average_examination_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - mean_share) AS average_share_minus_mean
FROM scored
WHERE share > mean_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct Examination.ID group, including a NULL ID group if present, is included; the denominator and unweighted mean are computed over those groups.
